g.text: TM01 Table I + frequency ablation | 50 shared seeds
95% Wilson intervals. Each dot is one of 50 episodes; black bar: mean time without a fall.
60 s is the fixed horizon. Errors on different surviving intervals are not ranked as full-task performance.
